verdict.rationale: Pipedream supports native HTTP/Webhook triggers for workflows and event sources, with CLI tooling (pd deploy, pd dev) to develop and stream events, plus a REST API/SSE stream to consume emitted events programmatically — enabling an AI-native user or agent to subscribe to and act on webhook events. MCP integration further lets agents invoke these triggers/tools directly. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of webhook subscription specifically in an agentic/AI workflow context, and more detail on event delivery guarantees for agent consumption.
